1. D:\Code\ai-infra\scripts\backup-critical-configs.ps1
PowerShell<#.SYNOPSIS每日增量备份 Claude Code / MCP / Agent 关键配置。.DESCRIPTION- 备份到：D:\Backup\yyyy-MM-dd\- 文件无变化则跳过复制- 保留最近 N 天备份目录- 写日志到 D:\Backup\backup.log- 所有路径均可通过参数覆盖#>[CmdletBinding()]param( [string]$BackupRoot = "D:\Backup", [string]$ProjectRoot = "D:\Code", [string]$UserClaudeRoot = (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".claude"), [string]$MemoryProjectKey = "D--Code", [int]$RetentionDays = 7, [string]$LogFile = "")Set-StrictMode -Version Latest$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($LogFile)) { $LogFile = Join-Path $BackupRoot "backup.log"}function Write-Log { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message, [ValidateSet("INFO", "WARN", "ERROR")][string]$Level = "INFO" ) $logDir = Split-Path -Parent $LogFile if (-not (Test-Path $logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force | Out-Null } $line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $Level, $Message Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 Write-Host $line}function Assert-SafeDirectory { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name ) if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) { throw "$Name 不能为空。" } $fullPath = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path) # 安全保护：禁止把根目录当作备份根目录，避免清理时误删。 $root = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($fullPath) if ($fullPath.TrimEnd("\") -eq $root.TrimEnd("\")) { throw "$Name 不能是磁盘根目录：$fullPath" } return $fullPath}function Get-FileHashSafe { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path) if (-not (Test-Path $Path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null } return (Get-FileHash -Path $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}function Get-PreviousBackupFile { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$RelativePath, [Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime]$Today ) if (-not (Test-Path $BackupRoot)) { return $null } $backupDirs = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$" } | ForEach-Object { try { [pscustomobject]@{ Date = [datetime]::ParseExact($_.Name, "yyyy-MM-dd", $null) Path = $_.FullName } } catch { $null } } | Where-Object { $_ -ne $null -and $_.Date.Date -lt $Today.Date } | Sort-Object Date -Descending foreach ($dir in $backupDirs) { $candidate = Join-Path $dir.Path $RelativePath if (Test-Path $candidate -PathType Leaf) { return [pscustomobject]@{ FilePath = $candidate Date = $dir.Date } } } return $null}function Copy-IfChanged { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourcePath, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$RelativePath, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$TodayBackupDir, [Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime]$Today, [Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime]$RetentionCutoff ) if (-not (Test-Path $SourcePath -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Log "源文件不存在，跳过：$SourcePath" "WARN" return [pscustomobject]@{ Source = $SourcePath Target = $null Status = "missing" } } $targetPath = Join-Path $TodayBackupDir $RelativePath $targetDir = Split-Path -Parent $targetPath if (-not (Test-Path $targetDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetDir -Force | Out-Null } $sourceHash = Get-FileHashSafe -Path $SourcePath # 先比较今天目录里的同名文件。 if (Test-Path $targetPath -PathType Leaf) { $todayHash = Get-FileHashSafe -Path $targetPath if ($sourceHash -eq $todayHash) { Write-Log "文件无变化，跳过：$RelativePath" return [pscustomobject]@{ Source = $SourcePath Target = $targetPath Status = "skipped_same_today" } } } # 再比较最近一次历史备份。 $previous = Get-PreviousBackupFile -RelativePath $RelativePath -Today $Today if ($null -ne $previous) { $previousHash = Get-FileHashSafe -Path $previous.FilePath # 如果历史文件相同，且历史备份仍在保留窗口内，则今天不重复复制。 if ($sourceHash -eq $previousHash -and $previous.Date.Date -ge $RetentionCutoff.Date) { Write-Log "文件较最近备份无变化，跳过：$RelativePath" return [pscustomobject]@{ Source = $SourcePath Target = $previous.FilePath Status = "skipped_same_previous" } } } Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $targetPath -Force Write-Log "已备份：$SourcePath -> $targetPath" return [pscustomobject]@{ Source = $SourcePath Target = $targetPath Status = "copied" }}function Remove-OldBackups { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime]$RetentionCutoff ) if (-not (Test-Path $BackupRoot)) { return } $dirs = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$" } foreach ($dir in $dirs) { try { $date = [datetime]::ParseExact($dir.Name, "yyyy-MM-dd", $null) if ($date.Date -lt $RetentionCutoff.Date) { Remove-Item -Path $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force Write-Log "已清理旧备份目录：$($dir.FullName)" } } catch { Write-Log "清理旧备份目录失败：$($dir.FullName)；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } }}try { $BackupRoot = Assert-SafeDirectory -Path $BackupRoot -Name "BackupRoot" $ProjectRoot = Assert-SafeDirectory -Path $ProjectRoot -Name "ProjectRoot" $UserClaudeRoot = Assert-SafeDirectory -Path $UserClaudeRoot -Name "UserClaudeRoot" if ($RetentionDays -lt 1) { throw "RetentionDays 必须大于等于 1。" } $today = Get-Date $dateName = $today.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") $todayBackupDir = Join-Path $BackupRoot $dateName $retentionCutoff = $today.Date.AddDays(-1 * ($RetentionDays - 1)) if (-not (Test-Path $todayBackupDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayBackupDir -Force | Out-Null } Write-Log "开始关键配置备份，目标目录：$todayBackupDir" $sources = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object] # 用户级 Claude 配置。 $sources.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source = Join-Path $UserClaudeRoot "settings.json" Relative = "UserClaude\settings.json" }) $sources.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source = Join-Path $UserClaudeRoot "settings.local.json" Relative = "UserClaude\settings.local.json" }) # 用户级 Claude memory。 $memoryDir = Join-Path $UserClaudeRoot ("projects\{0}\memory" -f $MemoryProjectKey) if (Test-Path $memoryDir -PathType Container) { Get-ChildItem -Path $memoryDir -Filter "*.md" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $sources.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source = $_.FullName Relative = "UserClaude\projects\$MemoryProjectKey\memory\$($_.Name)" }) } } else { Write-Log "memory 目录不存在，跳过：$memoryDir" "WARN" } # 项目级 Claude / MCP 配置。 $sources.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source = Join-Path $ProjectRoot ".claude\agent-router.json" Relative = "Project\.claude\agent-router.json" }) $sources.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source = Join-Path $ProjectRoot ".claude\settings.local.json" Relative = "Project\.claude\settings.local.json" }) $sources.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "CLAUDE.md" Relative = "Project\CLAUDE.md" }) $sources.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source = Join-Path $ProjectRoot ".mcp.json" Relative = "Project\.mcp.json" }) $results = foreach ($item in $sources) { Copy-IfChanged ` -SourcePath $item.Source ` -RelativePath $item.Relative ` -TodayBackupDir $todayBackupDir ` -Today $today ` -RetentionCutoff $retentionCutoff } Remove-OldBackups -RetentionCutoff $retentionCutoff $summary = $results | Group-Object Status | ForEach-Object { "{0}={1}" -f $_.Name, $_.Count } Write-Log "备份完成：$($summary -join ', ')" exit 0}catch { Write-Log "备份失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" exit 1}
2. D:\Code\ai-infra\scripts\health-check-daily.ps1
PowerShell<#.SYNOPSIS每日本机 AI 基础设施健康检查。.DESCRIPTION- 输出 JSON 到：D:\ai-infra\health\yyyy-MM-dd.json- 检查磁盘、内存、核心进程、端口、GPU、Docker、Windows Update- 结果分为 ok / warning / critical- warning / critical 会尝试推送桌面通知#>[CmdletBinding()]param( [string]$HealthRoot = "D:\ai-infra\health", [string]$LogFile = "", [int]$DiskWarnPercent = 80, [int]$MemoryWarnPercent = 80, [int]$LocalAgentPort = 9000, [string[]]$ProcessNames = @("claude", "node", "python", "uv"), [switch]$DisableDesktopNotification)Set-StrictMode -Version Latest$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($LogFile)) { $LogFile = Join-Path $HealthRoot "health-check.log"}function Write-Log { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message, [ValidateSet("INFO", "WARN", "ERROR")][string]$Level = "INFO" ) $logDir = Split-Path -Parent $LogFile if (-not (Test-Path $logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force | Out-Null } $line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $Level, $Message Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 Write-Host $line}function New-Check { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name, [ValidateSet("ok", "warning", "critical")][string]$Status, [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Data, [string]$Message = "" ) return [pscustomobject]@{ name = $Name status = $Status message = $Message data = $Data }}function Get-OverallStatus { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$Checks) if ($Checks | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "critical" }) { return "critical" } if ($Checks | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "warning" }) { return "warning" } return "ok"}function Test-TcpPort { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$HostName, [Parameter(Mandatory)][int]$Port, [int]$TimeoutMs = 2000 ) $client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient try { $async = $client.BeginConnect($HostName, $Port, $null, $null) $connected = $async.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne($TimeoutMs, $false) if (-not $connected) { return $false } $client.EndConnect($async) return $true } catch { return $false } finally { $client.Close() }}function Send-DesktopNotification { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Title, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message ) if ($DisableDesktopNotification) { return } try { # 优先使用 BurntToast；如果未安装，则使用 Windows Forms 气泡通知。 if (Get-Command New-BurntToastNotification -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { New-BurntToastNotification -Text $Title, $Message | Out-Null return } Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing $notify = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon $notify.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Warning $notify.BalloonTipTitle = $Title $notify.BalloonTipText = $Message $notify.Visible = $true $notify.ShowBalloonTip(5000) Start-Sleep -Seconds 6 $notify.Dispose() } catch { Write-Log "桌面通知发送失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" }}function Check-Disks { $checks = @() $targetDrives = @("C:", "D:") $disks = Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DriveType=3" foreach ($drive in $targetDrives) { $disk = $disks | Where-Object { $_.DeviceID -eq $drive } | Select-Object -First 1 if ($null -eq $disk) { $checks += New-Check -Name "disk_$drive" -Status "warning" -Message "未找到磁盘 $drive" -Data @{ drive = $drive } continue } $sizeGb = [math]::Round($disk.Size / 1GB, 2) $freeGb = [math]::Round($disk.FreeSpace / 1GB, 2) $usedPercent = [math]::Round((($disk.Size - $disk.FreeSpace) / $disk.Size) * 100, 2) $status = if ($usedPercent -ge $DiskWarnPercent) { "warning" } else { "ok" } $checks += New-Check -Name "disk_$drive" -Status $status -Message "磁盘 $drive 使用率 $usedPercent%" -Data @{ drive = $drive size_gb = $sizeGb free_gb = $freeGb used_percent = $usedPercent warn_percent = $DiskWarnPercent } } return $checks}function Check-Memory { $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem $totalKb = [double]$os.TotalVisibleMemorySize $freeKb = [double]$os.FreePhysicalMemory $usedPercent = [math]::Round((($totalKb - $freeKb) / $totalKb) * 100, 2) $status = if ($usedPercent -ge $MemoryWarnPercent) { "warning" } else { "ok" } return New-Check -Name "memory" -Status $status -Message "内存使用率 $usedPercent%" -Data @{ total_gb = [math]::Round($totalKb / 1MB, 2) free_gb = [math]::Round($freeKb / 1MB, 2) used_percent = $usedPercent warn_percent = $MemoryWarnPercent }}function Check-Processes { $items = @() foreach ($name in $ProcessNames) { $matched = Get-Process -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $items += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $name count = @($matched).Count pids = @($matched | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id) } } # 进程未运行不一定是致命错误，因为某些工具可能按需启动；这里设为 warning。 $missing = $items | Where-Object { $_.count -eq 0 } $status = if (@($missing).Count -gt 0) { "warning" } else { "ok" } return New-Check -Name "core_processes" -Status $status -Message "核心进程检查完成" -Data @{ processes = $items missing = @($missing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty name) }}function Check-LocalAgentPort { $open = Test-TcpPort -HostName "127.0.0.1" -Port $LocalAgentPort $status = if ($open) { "ok" } else { "critical" } return New-Check -Name "local_agent_port" -Status $status -Message "本地 Agent 端口 $LocalAgentPort 状态：$open" -Data @{ host = "127.0.0.1" port = $LocalAgentPort open = $open }}function Check-Gpu { $nvidiaSmi = Get-Command nvidia-smi -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $nvidiaSmi) { return New-Check -Name "gpu" -Status "warning" -Message "未找到 nvidia-smi，无法读取 NVIDIA GPU 状态" -Data @{ available = $false tool = "nvidia-smi" } } try { $queryArgs = @( "--query-gpu=name,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total,temperature.gpu" "--format=csv,noheader,nounits" ) $output = & $nvidiaSmi.Source @queryArgs 2>&1 if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { return New-Check -Name "gpu" -Status "warning" -Message "nvidia-smi 执行失败" -Data @{ available = $true output = ($output -join "`n") } } $gpus = @() foreach ($line in $output) { $parts = $line -split ",\s*" if ($parts.Count -ge 5) { $gpus += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $parts[0] utilization_percent = [int]$parts[1] memory_used_mb = [int]$parts[2] memory_total_mb = [int]$parts[3] temperature_celsius = [int]$parts[4] } } } $hotGpu = $gpus | Where-Object { $_.temperature_celsius -ge 85 -or $_.utilization_percent -ge 95 } $status = if (@($hotGpu).Count -gt 0) { "warning" } else { "ok" } return New-Check -Name "gpu" -Status $status -Message "GPU 状态检查完成" -Data @{ available = $true gpus = $gpus } } catch { return New-Check -Name "gpu" -Status "warning" -Message "GPU 检查异常：$($_.Exception.Message)" -Data @{ available = $true error = $_.Exception.Message } }}function Check-Docker { $docker = Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $docker) { return New-Check -Name "docker" -Status "warning" -Message "未找到 docker 命令" -Data @{ installed = $false } } try { $version = & $docker.Source version --format "{{.Server.Version}}" 2>$null if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($version)) { return New-Check -Name "docker" -Status "warning" -Message "Docker 已安装，但 daemon 可能未运行" -Data @{ installed = $true running = $false } } return New-Check -Name "docker" -Status "ok" -Message "Docker 正常运行" -Data @{ installed = $true running = $true server_version = $version } } catch { return New-Check -Name "docker" -Status "warning" -Message "Docker 检查异常：$($_.Exception.Message)" -Data @{ installed = $true running = $false error = $_.Exception.Message } }}function Check-WindowsUpdate { try { # 使用 Windows Update COM 接口检查未安装的软件更新。 $session = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session $searcher = $session.CreateUpdateSearcher() $result = $searcher.Search("IsInstalled=0 and Type='Software' and IsHidden=0") $count = $result.Updates.Count $titles = @() for ($i = 0; $i -lt $count; $i++) { $titles += $result.Updates.Item($i).Title } $status = if ($count -gt 0) { "warning" } else { "ok" } return New-Check -Name "windows_update" -Status $status -Message "待安装 Windows 更新数量：$count" -Data @{ pending_count = $count titles = $titles } } catch { return New-Check -Name "windows_update" -Status "warning" -Message "Windows 更新检查失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" -Data @{ error = $_.Exception.Message } }}try { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($HealthRoot)) { throw "HealthRoot 不能为空。" } if (-not (Test-Path $HealthRoot)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $HealthRoot -Force | Out-Null } Write-Log "开始每日健康检查。" $checks = @() $checks += Check-Disks $checks += Check-Memory $checks += Check-Processes $checks += Check-LocalAgentPort $checks += Check-Gpu $checks += Check-Docker $checks += Check-WindowsUpdate $overall = Get-OverallStatus -Checks $checks $report = [pscustomobject]@{ timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString("o") computer_name = $env:COMPUTERNAME user = $env:USERNAME overall_status = $overall checks = $checks } $dateName = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd" $reportPath = Join-Path $HealthRoot "$dateName.json" $report | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $reportPath -Encoding UTF8 Write-Log "健康检查完成：$overall；报告：$reportPath" if ($overall -ne "ok") { $badChecks = $checks | Where-Object { $_.status -ne "ok" } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty name Send-DesktopNotification ` -Title "AI 基础设施健康检查：$overall" ` -Message ("异常项：" + ($badChecks -join ", ")) } if ($overall -eq "critical") { exit 2 } if ($overall -eq "warning") { exit 1 } exit 0}catch { Write-Log "健康检查失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" try { Send-DesktopNotification ` -Title "AI 基础设施健康检查失败" ` -Message $_.Exception.Message } catch { # 通知失败不影响脚本失败结果。 } exit 2}
3. D:\Code\ai-infra\scripts\migrate-token-to-env.ps1
PowerShell<#.SYNOPSIS把 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 从用户级环境变量迁移到 .env.ps1。.DESCRIPTION步骤：1. 检测当前环境变量中是否存在目标 token2. 备份现有 .env.ps13. 将 token 写入 .env.ps14. 删除用户级永久环境变量5. 验证迁移结果6. 输出报告安全保护：- 不在日志或控制台输出 token 明文- 默认不删除机器级 Machine 环境变量- 写入后尝试收紧 .env.ps1 ACL- 支持 -WhatIf#>[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]param( [string]$EnvFile = "D:\Code\ai-pipeline\.env.ps1", [string]$VariableName = "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN", [string]$BackupDirectory = "", [string]$LogFile = "", [bool]$HardenAcl = $true)Set-StrictMode -Version Latest$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"function Write-Log { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message, [ValidateSet("INFO", "WARN", "ERROR")][string]$Level = "INFO" ) $logDir = Split-Path -Parent $LogFile if (-not (Test-Path $logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force | Out-Null } $line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $Level, $Message Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 Write-Host $line}function Protect-SecretFileAcl { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path) if (-not $HardenAcl) { return } if (-not (Test-Path $Path -PathType Leaf)) { return } try { $acl = Get-Acl -Path $Path $acl.SetAccessRuleProtection($true, $false) foreach ($rule in @($acl.Access)) { [void]$acl.RemoveAccessRule($rule) } $currentUser = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User $systemSid = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier("S-1-5-18") $adminsSid = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier("S-1-5-32-544") $rights = [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::FullControl $inheritance = [System.Security.AccessControl.InheritanceFlags]::None $propagation = [System.Security.AccessControl.PropagationFlags]::None $type = [System.Security.AccessControl.AccessControlType]::Allow $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($currentUser, $rights, $inheritance, $propagation, $type))) $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($systemSid, $rights, $inheritance, $propagation, $type))) $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($adminsSid, $rights, $inheritance, $propagation, $type))) Set-Acl -Path $Path -AclObject $acl Write-Log "已收紧文件 ACL：$Path" } catch { Write-Log "收紧 ACL 失败，但迁移可继续；文件：$Path；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" }}function Escape-PowerShellSingleQuotedString { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Value) # PowerShell 单引号字符串中，单引号需要写成两个单引号。 return $Value.Replace("'", "''")}function Backup-EnvFile { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourceFile, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$TargetBackupDirectory ) if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Log ".env.ps1 不存在，跳过备份：$SourceFile" "WARN" return $null } if (-not (Test-Path $TargetBackupDirectory)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TargetBackupDirectory -Force | Out-Null } $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss" $fileName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($SourceFile) $backupPath = Join-Path $TargetBackupDirectory "$fileName.$timestamp.bak" Copy-Item -Path $SourceFile -Destination $backupPath -Force Protect-SecretFileAcl -Path $backupPath Write-Log "已备份 .env.ps1：$backupPath" return $backupPath}function Upsert-EnvAssignment { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$TargetFile, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SecretValue ) $escapedName = [regex]::Escape($Name) $escapedSecret = Escape-PowerShellSingleQuotedString -Value $SecretValue $assignmentLine = '$env:{0} = ''{1}''' -f $Name, $escapedSecret $commentLine = "# 由 migrate-token-to-env.ps1 迁移写入；请勿提交到 Git。" if (-not (Test-Path $TargetFile -PathType Leaf)) { Set-Content -Path $TargetFile -Value @( "# 本地私有环境变量文件。" "# 使用方式：在 PowerShell 中执行：. `"$TargetFile`"" $commentLine $assignmentLine ) -Encoding UTF8 Write-Log "已创建 .env.ps1 并写入变量：$Name" return "created" } $content = Get-Content -Path $TargetFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $pattern = "(?m)^\s*\`$env:$escapedName\s*=.*$" if ($content -match $pattern) { $newContent = [regex]::Replace($content, $pattern, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($match) return $assignmentLine }) Set-Content -Path $TargetFile -Value $newContent -Encoding UTF8 Write-Log "已更新 .env.ps1 中的变量：$Name" return "updated" } Add-Content -Path $TargetFile -Value "" -Encoding UTF8 Add-Content -Path $TargetFile -Value $commentLine -Encoding UTF8 Add-Content -Path $TargetFile -Value $assignmentLine -Encoding UTF8 Write-Log "已追加变量到 .env.ps1：$Name" return "appended"}function Test-EnvFileContainsVariable { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$TargetFile, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name ) if (-not (Test-Path $TargetFile -PathType Leaf)) { return $false } $content = Get-Content -Path $TargetFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $escapedName = [regex]::Escape($Name) return ($content -match "(?m)^\s*\`$env:$escapedName\s*=")}try { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($EnvFile)) { throw "EnvFile 不能为空。" } if ($VariableName -notmatch "^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$") { throw "VariableName 非法：$VariableName" } $envDirectory = Split-Path -Parent $EnvFile if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($envDirectory)) { throw "EnvFile 必须包含目录路径。" } if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($BackupDirectory)) { $BackupDirectory = Join-Path $envDirectory "backups" } if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($LogFile)) { $LogFile = Join-Path $envDirectory "migrate-token-to-env.log" } if (-not (Test-Path $envDirectory)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $envDirectory -Force | Out-Null } Write-Log "开始迁移环境变量：$VariableName" $userToken = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($VariableName, "User") $processToken = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($VariableName, "Process") $machineToken = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($VariableName, "Machine") $sourceScope = $null $tokenToMigrate = $null if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($userToken)) { $sourceScope = "User" $tokenToMigrate = = $sourceScope env_file = $EnvFile backup_file = $backupPath write_status = $writeStatus user_variable_removed = [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($verifyUser) process_variable_set = -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($verifyProcess) machine_variable_set = -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($verifyMachine) env_file_has_variable = $envFileHasVariable verification_status = $verificationStatus notes
